snippet.title: Soul Injector Commando Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for the video game Soul Injector Commando. All the billionaires in the world are trapped in an elaborate underground bunker and you are tasked by God to inject souls into every last one of them so they give up their evil ways and get jobs like everyone else. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3220370/Soul_Injector_Commando/
